triggering_evidence.confirmed_finding: Revision 2 ranks frame units with a checked-in literal salt. This deterministically freezes a subset but does not instantiate the random sampling mechanism required for design-based inclusion probabilities n_h/N_h and exact hypergeometric coverage.

reasons: Revision-2 policy and implementation bytes are already frozen and bound into historical collection decisions.
Mutating revision 2 would change its implementation/configuration hashes, decision IDs, and completed independent-audit bindings.
The existing b0bb67 decision has action collect_next_tranche and contains no frame, so the sampling defect does not invalidate that collection authorization.
A frame-only correction can be applied prospectively without rewriting label-blind collection history.
It preserves immutable v1/v2 collection lineage.
It separates collection stopping and eligible-population construction from the one-time probability sample draw.
It can bind the actual frozen population and fresh pre-label entropy before any semantic annotation.
It avoids implying that previously emitted deterministic fixed-salt rankings were probability samples.

allowed: verify the frozen revision-1 policy and implementation
load the exact unlabeled observation prefix
construct problem_group x alpha_identity_fingerprint scientific units
compute label-blind counts and coverage deficits
not_authorized: claim simple random sampling without replacement
assign design-based inclusion probabilities to a fixed-salt subset
start semantic annotation from a revision-2 frame
revision_2_scope_after_addendum.operational_stop_rule: If revision 2 would emit a frame-freeze action, stop before persistence or annotation and require the prospective revision-3 frame-freeze amendment.

must_be_frozen_before: LLM judgment used as a semantic label
required_input_bindings: exact revision-2 policy and implementation hashes
exact final label-blind observation-prefix manifest IDs and hashes
exact problem-pool record and manifest hashes
one unique population row per problem_group x alpha_identity_fingerprint
complete contributor multiplicities and artifact lineage
frozen stratum definitions, N_h values, target total, and n_h allocation

eligible_population_freeze.order: population bytes and population SHA-256 are finalized before entropy is obtained
eligible_population_freeze.required_reconciliation: population rows, stratum totals, contributor multiplicities, and observation-prefix candidates reconcile exactly

randomness.source: one fresh OS CSPRNG draw with archived provenance, or a precommitted public randomness beacon sampled after the population hash is frozen

selection_algorithm.required: versioned keyed cryptographic rank such as HMAC-SHA-256(seed, domain_separator || stratum || frame_unit_id)
selection_algorithm.select: the n_h lowest unique ranks without replacement

output_bindings: population manifest ID, artifact path, SHA-256, and item count
seed provenance ID, artifact path, and SHA-256
selected frame artifact, SHA-256, and item count
frame decision ID hashing every preceding binding
immutability: a second identical run is byte-identical
a different seed, population, allocation, implementation, or selected frame cannot overwrite the first decision
the prevalence estimator consumes and verifies the revision-3 decision/frame binding rather than an unbound JSONL

statistical_interpretation.with_revision_3_random_draw: Conditional on the frozen stratified design and a correctly implemented one-time random draw, n_h/N_h design weights and exact finite-population hypergeometric inversion are methodologically supportable.
statistical_interpretation.without_revision_3_random_draw: Any fixed-salt frame is a deterministic purposive subset. Exact design-based confidence claims must be removed or downgraded to descriptive analysis under an explicitly stated hash-as-random heuristic.

real_reporting_also_requires: PREV-B02 decision/frame provenance verification by the estimator
PREV-B06 single-read input hashing and parsing
remaining_prevalence_boundaries.effect: Revision 3 fixes the randomization defect but does not by itself close the other confirmed prevalence-audit blockers.
